facts.fact: IDRC reports a grant implemented by Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology for a three-day workshop in Accra, Ghana, from 2023-12-01, bringing responsible-AI researchers and civil-society groups together on AI governance.
facts.system: Global Index on Responsible AI / AI4D II program planning workshop

GHA.note: A donor workshop with researchers, not a government consultation on a named law or policy.
